audit.method: Direct model translation followed by a complete source-target editorial reading of Grandpa’s third-year evaluation and re-evaluation scenes and Emily’s completed magic-outfit gift. Every spoken line, gender branch, farm-name placeholder, family and legacy statement, clothing reward message, crafting reference, and affectionate beat was reviewed in full event context with canonical Stardew Valley, Fiber and Emily’s Magic Boots terminology and consistent names for the complete outfit. Event commands, actors, movement, timing, evaluation and world-state commands, reward items, placeholders, gender and dialogue delimiters, emotion markers, music and sound IDs, and non-text payloads were preserved and structurally compared with English. The remaining FarmHouse records and full-locale final audits remain pending.
